o.text: Internationalism; via Russian репертуа́р (repertuár), from French répertoire, ultimately from Medieval Latin repertōrium.
From Proto-Turkic *yum (“round”). Possibly related to Azerbaijani yumruq (“fist”) and Azerbaijani yumurta (“egg”).

From pay + -la.
The sense 3 is probably an extension of vermək (“to put out”), which literally translates as "to give".
